_comment: Fictional fixture: Brindlefen, its founder, its pilot and its numbers do not exist.
one_liner: Brindlefen tracks repairs and sends status texts for independent bike workshops.
what_it_is: A repair board for independent bike workshops. Each bike has a card, and customers get a text when their repair moves.

icp.who: Owners of independent bike workshops with two to six mechanics
pains: The phone rings while hands are covered in grease
jobs: Keep customers informed without stopping work

offer.core: A repair board with automatic status texts

positioning.against: A paper ledger and a ringing phone
positioning.promise: Customers know where their bike is without calling the workshop
proof: 18 independent workshops ran the Brindlefen pilot between June and September 2026
Status texts go out automatically when a repair moves to done

voice.claims_policy: no invented stats, every metric must trace to a URL or be omitted
